business_problem: Ada's voice-support agents needed an online retrieval path that met a tighter latency budget while maintaining answer quality and multi-region, multi-tenant scale. Offline customer knowledge-base indexing also needed efficient bulk embedding.
solution_summary: Ada split retrieval into separate online and offline workloads after benchmarking four embedding approaches against quality, latency, and scale. For offline knowledge-base indexing, Cohere Model Vault runs bulk embedding and ingestion on Cohere-managed dedicated infrastructure. For live retrieval, Ada self-hosts Cohere Embed on dedicated Amazon SageMaker AI instances, where the model converts customer content and queries into numerical representations for semantic matching. SageMaker AI's proximity to Ada's services helps fit the voice latency budget; Model Vault's managed autoscaling handles republishing spikes. Embed's native compression reduces vector storage needs without a measurable retrieval loss. Retrieved knowledge feeds Ada's Reasoning Engine so customer-specific AI agents can answer support conversations. The page names no vector database or separate query service.

With Cohere Embed on SageMaker AI, Ada achieved median retrieval latency of 77 milliseconds (ms).
For offline workloads, Model Vault delivered approximately 2.7x greater throughput-per-dollar than Ada's self-hosted setup.
The team reduced its vector storage footprint by 4x with no measurable retrieval degradation.
